about_the_game:
Set against the backdrop of the 700-year-old painting Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty, this game features 200 meticulously drawn cats, bringing whimsical interactions between felines and the grand historical scene.

The original scroll of Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty measures 59 cm by 1240 cm and vividly depicts the royal hunt, encampment, and banquet of Yuan Dynasty emperors. The composition is epic in scale, with dynamic character portrayals that reflect the distinct features of Mongolian nobility. A highlight of the painting is the scene where the crown prince and warriors gallop on horseback to hunt deer, a moment rich with symbolic meaning.

Game Features

  • Relax and enjoy a journey through ancient artwork

  • 200 uniquely illustrated cats

  • Calming, traditional-style ancient music

  • Adorable cat sound effects

  • 100 carefully designed achievement icons

Gameplay Tips

  • Click the cover logo to view a high-resolution version of Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty

  • Press the ESC key to show or hide in-game buttons

  • Click the hint button to reveal the location of one cat—usable once every 60 seconds

Embark on a relaxing search for hidden cats in the majestic ancient scroll Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty!
